description: Edits one saved staffing rule the solver reads (rule_id, from the staffing rules grid or save_scheduling_rule), as editing the rule's row does: value in the rule's unit (0-1440 minutes; 0/1 for duration_basis), optional hardness (hard: never break it; soft: avoid when possible) and reason. At least one of value, hardness or reason must change. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_scheduling_rule
title: Edit a staffing rule
